title: VIRTUAL SINGER Chapter1 Episode12 MEIKO's New Menu

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. This new menu is looking good.
I'm sure everyone is going to love it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO, you here?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hi, Miku. Come on in. Are you here to help out again?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I've already finished cleaning for the day, though.
You're welcome to just relax for a while.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is that so? In that case, could I get a coffee?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course. Oh, I just finished putting together a new menu yesterday. How would you like to be a taste tester for—

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey there, MEIKO! How's it going?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh hello, Len. As energetic as ever, I see.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And Miku's here, too. You lending MEIKO a hand again?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
She said I could have the day off.
I just ordered a coffee.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, yeah? In that case, could I get a coffee too?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Len, wouldn't you rather have an orange juice?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: N-No! I was already thinking about ordering a coffee today!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You don't always have to treat me like a kid, you know.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You two really do get along, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Huh? What gives you that idea?
Not that I really care, though.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Here, Len, you can have an orange juice for now. I have a feeling this will go better with my new menu item, anyway.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh? A new item? What is it?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Coffee jelly. It's not sweet like fruit or ice cream is.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, that's too bad.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're such a kid.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wh-What?! No! It's not like I'm disappointed or anything!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I love coffee jelly! I can drink coffee too, you know!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I like them so much that I could even have them together!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. It's cute to see you acting all grown up.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmph! I'm not acting!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
All right, then. You like coffee, we get it.
But MEIKO already poured you some orange juice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, now that you're here, Len, I think I'm going to step out for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
MEIKO, I'll try that coffee jelly when I get back.
Len, go ahead and start without me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: All right. Take care.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Where are you going, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I've got to go get ready. I have a feeling we'll be getting some visitors soon.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Visitors? You mean the ones who created this place?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll be back in a little while.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh?! Miku, wait!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: There she goes...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
No fair! I want to go with her!
Miku is always leaving me behind!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh dear. If that's the case, then you should just be honest and tell her you'd like to join her.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Even if I did, she'd just go off on her own.
That's how she always is.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: All right. Next time, I'll try asking her myself if she'll take you with her.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's not like I absolutely have to go with her or anything... But thanks, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You're most welcome.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know you may be a little disappointed, but I'm glad to have you here to try my coffee jelly.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really? Hehe. I'm great at taste testing! Bring it on!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wonderful. I've got some whipped cream left too, so I'll give you a nice big dollop on top.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Here you are.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wow, it looks so good! Thanks, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm a little bummed I couldn't go with Miku, but I guess taking over for her as shop assistant from time to time isn't so bad.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'm happy to hear you say so.
And I'll be sure to talk to her for you the next time she's here.
